_comment: I-376 ramp from the Bilgewater Lumber Yard floor up onto the shelf toward Lost Peak. Band between two in-game .gps edges: west lower (1791.1648, -10943.389, 39.913) -> upper (1797.6177, -10972.466, 55.125); east lower (1804.1101, -10933.831, 35.768) -> upper (1811.4805, -10970.815, 50.476). terrain_raise only (never lowers). 6 ramp lines 3 yd apart across the band; on each, points 1 yd apart from 12 yd before the lower end to the upper end. Each line's target is the lowest surface that stays >= the stock ground and never climbs steeper than 28 deg (backward pass from the top, so a step in the ground is met by raising the approach before it). Each point carries the target from inner (4 yd) behind it, because a raised disk lifts the ground ahead of it by its inner radius; outer 7. Simulated: every line <= ~32 deg over any 1 yd except the west edge 33.6; max raise ~9 yd. Tested in PATCH-Z on a copy of the stock Open Azeroth tile and approved by the user (2026-10-08); now applied to the patch-open-azeroth tile and shipped in PATCH-O (--build). The recipe lives with the I-376 hunter chain. Server maps/vmaps/mmaps for tile 52_28 still need re-extracting.
